STEP 4 - Area: Pastry pieces cover about 12% of the plate (~54 cm^2). Filling visible within the pastry is included in that. Herb garnish ~1% (~5 cm^2). Crumbs negligible. Total food coverage ≈ 13%.

STEP 6 - Grams: Pastry (bread-like) 160 ml x 0.9 ≈ 145 g... this is a hollow, folded piece with air pockets, so the realistic pastry mass is closer to 80 g. Herb garnish 3 ml x 0.15 ≈ 0.5 g, round to 2 g given leaves' stems.

STEP 7 - Energy: Baked pastry with savory filling ≈ 300 kcal/100 g (pastry with some fat and cheese/meat filling). 80 g x 3.0 = 240 kcal. Herb garnish ≈ 30 kcal/100 g x 2 g ≈ 1 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single folded pastry-type item of roughly 80 g is plausible for what is visible; it is a small portion on a large plate, consistent with the ~13% coverage. Total ≈ 82 g, ~241 kcal.
